Lachie: Not a nasty bone in his body does this man possess, and he's more powerful than he has any idea about. He might even be the Western World's answer to the Buddha, true story…
Lachlan: Well educated and healthy, Lachlan is a polite man who never does wrong by others.
Lachy: Lachy has plenty of friends – both female and male – he never gets morbidly depressed, which means he’s a great remedy for those who are, and he does well in any outdoor life where there is plenty of sun-on-skin.
Laidlaw: Laidlaw is the kind of fellow who divvies out splendid advice because he has quite the gift at assessing the bigger picture, although he is useless at transferring this insight to his own life. Why is that Laidlaw? No one is sure, but as we keep saying up here in the commentary box, each of us is perfect within the bounds of our own imperfections. Laidlaw knows this too, which is why he's pretty relaxed. His ego is just fine.
Laighton:
Laighton is an active man with an active imagination. He may not own one, but he'd love a jet-ski, maybe even a snow-mobile. He'd settle for a horse but he finds them deeply unsettling. While he can't enunciate his feelings on this, we can: 

If you can't put petrol in it, Laighton wont get on it.

And fair enough too. I suppose it points to the fact that it takes a while for Laighton to trust individuals (and horses) but he'll get there. Especially once he figures out what he really wants from his life.
Laike: A modern man who, so far, has avoided any serious hardship or test in his life. That will come in time, as it must for all of us eventually, and in the meantime he learns quickly from mistakes and rarely bears a grudge.
Laikin: Laikin tends to hold it together and he doesn't leak much, be it money, drunk secrets or career opportunities that are worth following up.
Laith: The arrogant and rather slow-moving (lazy) Goose.
Lamb: Sheep’s little brother who has travelled more, is more outgoing and is generally funnier than not only his brother, but just about anyone else in the room. Lamb is young at heart and we suspect he will ever be thus, amen.
Lambros: Lambros is the kind of fellow who inherits millions of dollars and quite quickly blows the lot in having a grand old time, and doing little for either the planet or those in need. That’s not to say he isn’t fun to be around, he absolutely is, but in a crisis situation it might pay to give the keys to someone else.
Lance: The Jack Russell that thinks he’s a rhinoceros. He expects women to fall at his feet, which they occasionally do, and he has a very mediocre I.Q.
Langdon: A text-book smart arse and sarcastic prick. How he manages to keep all these friends is beyond all of us, up here watching.
Lars: Sure, his demeanour is occasionally quite serious and austere, but not once you get to know him. He speaks his mind, which, while confronting for many, only gets things done faster and eradicates those mistakes which stem from hesitation and procrastination, and if he does make a mistake he'll be quick to admit to it. When he plays tennis he likes to wear an all-white outfit.
Larz: The stern-looking astronomer. (He's actually just contemplating the latest x-ray spectrum.)
Laslo: Laslo is wise, he has time and he knows that a poor outcome doesn’t necessarily mean disaster in the long run. Indeed, they often produce the best memories. And he goes out of his way to produce more sexual intrigue in a week than most people contemplate in a year.
Lathan: A deep sea fisherman?…..not a chance. Lathan wears a suit and deals with marketing plans and product launches. Metaphorically, he’s like one of those pistachio nuts that looks like it will crack open easily, but only succeeds in cracking your tooth.
Lau: Picture the God of Neptune in the form of a Solomon Islander chief, enjoying a peaceful snorkel over the front of a pristine coral reef with his two kids following closely behind him. Welcome to Lau.
Laurence:
77% of Laurences have spent so much time being proper that those parts of their brain that hunger for thrills and excitement have completely shut down. What is left is a doleful old soul who quietly shuffles around the house in a subconscious quest for the answer to the question of why life seems so unfulfilling. (Laurence, if this is you, break some laws. Just for the hell of it and for a bit of chaos in your morning. Who knows? It might be fun?…)

The remaining 23% of Laurences are as kinky as hell, and will happily go for a walk into town with a butt plug firmly implanted, for no other reason than to smile and talk to strangers. 

Both are doing their job in the world.
Lawrence: Subtle. Lawrence conducts the London Philharmonic Orchestra and when he’s not skiing with the family in Switzerland, he enjoys being whipped by a dominatrix in a Danish dungeon.
Lawrie: If a pack of irrational idiots ever corner you and decide to try and beat you up on the street somewhere, then Lawrie is a good man to step from out of the shadows and help out. The idiots, I suspect, would live to greatly regret it.
Lawson: A tall man who stands very straight. He keeps a neat study and gets angry if his highly disciplined children become too rowdy.
Layton: He's a kinky fucker all right. Layton would pay a lot of money to be able to travel back in time to New York in the 1970s and party in some of those clubs that became world famous. And yes, these days he spends a couple of months on the island of Ibiza, Spain. Layton.
Lazar: This Serbian is quick to pull the trigger.
Lazarus: There are a few of them out there in the Kingdom and here we have another one, although you should probably know that he is the best, whatever you think you know about the industry or your own psychology. He'll find a way to make you believe what he's saying, irrespective. Possible occupations: Used car salesman/arms dealer/politician/speech writer...you get the gist.
Lea: Never impolite and never a softy, Lea presents to the world in the same way as a well-prepared Christmas fruit cake. He is complex, yet he is also simple in his stance and he is never quite what you expect. He never rushes yet he loves an impromptu gathering. He makes no apologies and rarely seeks adulation. He is thoughtful and he is humorous. He is friendly and he is intelligent. And yes, Lea is an unusual name for a man and why not.
Lee: Lee is a straight-up bloke, but he might be a little bit impatient, or something, and there is a 70% chance that he is completely predictable.
Leif: Leif is hard to pin down and in confronting situations, like a cat, he always manages to land on his feet. The only place he wears a tie is at weddings and his point of view is usually unexpected and accurate. He’s not as flakey as we were led to believe.
Leigh: Stubborn, he may be, but he’s definitely more experimental than one might imagine. If he starts a project he won't be distracted until it’s finished, and he is far more intelligent than those around him. And if he’s a kinky little fucker then you’d have no idea.
Leith: Union heavyweight, he is not. Highly educated, he is. Polite at dinner parties, almost always. An appreciator of fine wines, absolutely. Well travelled, you got it. And does he remember when he was wronged and by whom?..... You better believe it. And if you’re the perpetrator then you’ll need eyes in the back of your head for a very long time.
Lemisio: Lemisio lives in the US of A. He's fit, he dresses in brightly coloured body-hugging outfits, he has a big smile on his face and he is extremely skilled at tossing small girls into the air (and catching them) at American football games to the tune of a big brass band playing in front of him. Yes, he's a male cheerleader, and he's good.
Len: Len is a chainsaw in need of a decent service. He runs okay and cuts what he needs to cut, but he's beyond the point of being discrete about anything.
Leo: Leo has aspired to be a porn star since he could walk. Indeed, he’s so enamoured with his own persona that he sometimes makes pornos on his own.
Leon: Okay, so yes, once upon a time we described Leon as one of the great apes, who lived in the jungle, loved bananas and was completely illiterate, but we think it’s time to fess up. Leon has a sense of humour, you bet, but he’s way more interesting and invigorating than some kind of kinky gibbon. Leon is into life and unusual life paths, and we are delighted to see him playing tonight. (Word on the street is that he’s been training hard in the pre-season, which, now that we think about it, isn’t surprising at all. He’s quite determined when he sets his sights on something.)
Leonard: Camilla’s betrothed. He’s bigger than she is but they smell the same. Ain’t love grand?
Leroy: A criminal. He stuffs socks down his jocks to try and make his cock look bigger. He’s a funny guy, though, regardless that he spends a lot of time trying to talk to girls from side on.
Les: If ever Les feels tired and lacks the time or desire for a nap, he will stand and face the nearest wall before head-butting a hole in it. That wakes him up, no worries.
Leslie: Leslie is a thoughtful man who, if not well passed middle age, is knee-deep in it. Mild-mannered and inoffensive, he has read more books than exist in a small library and our only real concern is that there aren’t many other Leslies left in the wild. If you meet one you should alert the nearest national museum – although there is a slim chance that he may actually work there, already.
Lester: “....Alright,” you smirk. “What’s he done this time?”
Levi: Levi has lots of friends, a big mouth and he's a smart arse when he wants to be. Yes, he’s been in the odd fist fight and he takes all of this in his stride.
Lewis: A smart and occasionally intense young man who often seems preoccupied.
Lex: He could be anything on the surface – an ogre or a gentleman – but at his core he is a slippery shit-stirrer who loves a good time.
Lexy: See the female Lexy, although you couldn’t really say that the male one is all that beautiful – quite the opposite, actually – and not that he’d give a shit, anyway.
Leyton: Leyton is lucid and contained like an Olympic swimming pool, except that the lanes must be clearly marked, and it would be appreciated if the chemicals in the water react with urine to produce a colour so that the offender can be detected and ejected as quickly as possible.
Liam: Liam is a feisty little bastard that has no compunction in jobbing a man in the face who is twice his size. Sometimes he does it just for the fun of the ensuing brawl.
Lillias: Why do I get the feeling that I'm about to walk into the National Museum stark bollock naked? (Although, he is first cousins with a man called Vernon.)
Lincoln: A nice bloke but a bit sleazy, or lazy or something.
Linden: Linden slots well into any hierarchal system of work and/or governance and is never destined to slog it out on the factory floor. Thoughtful and honest, he rarely lies although he’s a little predictable in bed…..or is he??
Lindsay: Isn’t it strange that ‘Lindsay’ on a woman is quite masculine, yet on a man it’s quite feminine? Anyway, the male version hardly ever panics and this grace under pressure allows him to remain quite methodical amid the turmoil. Such is life and such is Lindsay.
Lino: A little arrogant. A little impassive.
Linton: A genteel fellow. Quiet of speech, he takes great pleasure in sipping at a nice hot cup of camomile tea.
Lionel: Lionel prefers cold toast in the morning, sherry of an evening, and he takes a long time to do anything. But, seriously, what’s the rush?
Lisandro: Si, Italiano. Which makes him musical and a good cook and an outrageous flirt, but he struggles with stiff competition. It's not that he likes the easy way out, it's just that he's used to cruising.
Liv: Educated, gentle, humorous, inquisitive and insightful. In fact.......no, you know what?...That says it all. Thanks Liv.
Livinio: Listen, Livinio, sometimes there are no shortcuts. Sometimes you just have to roll your sleeves up, accept that the rewards are going to be hard-fought and hard-earned and just dig in for the hard slog. In case you haven't worked it out it's never not worth it. As we keep saying up here in the commentary box, life's lessons rarely arrive at the anticipated finish line.
LJ: "Here comes the ball now and look, in his usual casual style, LJ swoops down and grabs it, balks effortlessly around two opponents and hands off to a team mate running past. As usual, he made that move look easy. No, he's not the fastest in the team but his natural awareness allows him to assess his surroundings, which means he's rarely caught. Indeed, he rarely looks stressed about anything and he sleeps a hell of a lot, so they say…”
Llewellyn: His parents would love him to finish law school and do the family proud, but he’s about sick and tired of the pre-programmed bullshit. From here on is anyone’s guess because now that he’s out of the ‘cage’ anything is possible. Last I heard he was talking about hitchhiking nude across America. Did that ever happen?…
Lloyd: Lloyd speaks very correctly, collects Jaguar motorcars and wears v-neck jumpers above long sleeve shirts. Unfortunately his permanent ad in the ‘Personal’ section of the local newspaper seems to go unnoticed, but he hasn’t lost faith that a very nice Mrs.Lloyd is out there, somewhere. Good luck, lad.
Lochaden: Super chilled-out and relaxed, I don’t think so. Lochaden likes to set goals and achieve them, he enjoys positions of power and influence, he thinks he has a sense of humour and he checks his share portfolio several times each day.
Lockier: Fire retardant, and we’re not sure it’s legal to have a functioning office without at least of few of them placed strategically around each floor.
Logan: Logan has very long eye lashes that makes every woman say yes to him (but, will this affection make him lazy and overconfident?....)
Loic: His name is actually Gaelic for Louis, and it rumbles passed you like a giant ocean swell as you say it, which makes sense. Loic is the King of the Seas.
Loki: Loki should go and live in a polygamous community because he gets divorced and re-married to someone new every three years. So what's that now, 9 marriages, is it? Loki isn't really one for working through problems. If it doesn't work and you can't fix it in the first hour, get rid of it: this is Loki's mantra. He consequently pays a lot of money in alimony although his kids love him still, and that's what really matters. He's quite a laid-back fellow.
London: Have his parents ever visited there? In winter, especially? Fuck knows. Anyway, the fact is that London is a pretty normal sort of a dude. He’s not a slick corporate fellow and he’s probably more suited to a job that gets him outside, if only for the fact it’ll keep a lid on his ego and provide him with a wholesome sense of what’s important.
Lookaway: Nice guy with a wonky eye.
Loren: He's never heard of a thing called road rage and he always gives people the space to figure out what they want. He's never attempted a practical joke on anyone or any group, although he'd be great at it only because he's the last person anyone would suspect.
Lorenzo: Lorenzo is a happy guy, usually, who is currently serving a three-year sentence for fraud.
Lorne: People expect him to be a natural leader but this isn't really the case. It's hard work that Lorne struggles with, and how can you be the exalted leader of a company, family or community group when you sleep 10 hours every day? Something has to give. But, Lorne is a happy man who isn't a fool, and it's probably more than we hoped for.
Lote: The name of Shirley Temple’s favourite little pink dress.
Lou: A middle-aged fellow who loves to dress up in women’s clothes more than any other. If he was born in the late 80’s he’d now be a transsexual.
Louie: B-grade actor. A-grade clown. Thankfully he'd be a waste of time in the armed forces. But then again……maybe we should consider him for the marines and arm him with fruit, nuts and chocolates so he could storm the beaches with love?...
Louis: Slick with a line and slick with the hair gel, his life begins and ends with the pursuit of beautiful women (if he's into them, that is).
Lowell: Lowell is the university professor who is hated (feared) by his peers due to his radical but brilliantly implemented and highly effective teaching methods. He dresses like a drunk blind man, his glasses sit oddly on his face and his students simply adore his humour and his insight. And yes, in his undergraduate days he did indeed spend three days alone in the desert in the nude.
Loy: Rarely, if ever, contemptible, Loy doesn't hang around with the rabble. His name swirls around quickly and then up into the air, in the same way that you might pour a jug of lukewarm chocolate milk into a mug before guzzling it down as fast as you can. When you finish, you always ask yourself why you don't drink more of the stuff. Indeed, why don't you? Loy tends to leave us feeling this way, and it's a rather pleasant and surprising skill to possess.
Lozza: About as subtle as a brick, Lozza has a perpetually dirty face that somehow fits his persona of a constantly smiling and hard-working builder.
Luc: For such a mysterious cat Luc manages to tie together the various aspects and workings of his life very efficiently. He never panics, at least, he never puts himself in a position of ever needing to, and people admire and often seek out his rather artistic advice. Why he looks more serious than his peers has us scratching our heads up here in the commentary box because underneath he’s quite a happy guy. The only thing we can tell  you for certain about Luc is that he should avoid all military service. He’s just too sensitive to be constantly yelled at and, more than that, he’s very good in his own company.
Luca: Luca didn't start to train hard until his team was relegated to the second division. After being quite lazy for a while he has developed into a fantastic player. His team loves him, but he'll always shun the spot-light.
Lucan: No, you'll never find Lucan at embroidery class. (You can do that anywhere, and so where's the prestige in that?) A French class in Paris, maybe? Perhaps a course on the finer points of early model BMW motorcycle engines, in Germany? (It's why Lucan decided to learn German) Or maybe he'll travel to that famous village in Borneo (famous in entomology circles, that is) to study butterflies. You never can tell. What you can expect, however, is that Lucan, via his own methods and without influence, will find his loves in life and then pursue them in a quiet and dogmatic fashion. And yep, girls love him, mostly because he seems so mysterious.
Lucas: Ah, Lucas Pukas, good morning. How’s life? So, okay, let’s come clean here. Lucas, the name, does sound like something the dog throws up onto the kitchen floor after too many salt n’ vinegar chips, which isn’t a pretty picture now, is it? But, it’s nice to see you’ve ignored that little nickname. Your school report here in front of me says you’re doing well, actually. It says you’re energetic, if not just a tiny bit shy, and after some consultation, my colleagues and I believe you’ll thrive once you leave school, so keep at it. You’re blessed with tenacity, young man, and our only advice is that, once you’re out in the real world, try not to be too reactive to disagreeable people or situations that you’re confront with, unless things are serious, naturally. Beyond that, you’re a loyal young man and we don’t expect that to change. Good luck!
Lucca: Normally, Lucca is a placid man with charisma and style. If pushed beyond any level of common decency, however, he might snap and become dangerous. He speaks ill of no one unless they’re in front of him and deserve it, and he rides a big black motorcycle that, like the man himself, is just as potent as it looks.
Lucian: Lucian travels plenty and appreciates diversity in nearly all aspects of life. Open and friendly, thoughtful as well, he spends almost no time being bored because what is the bloody point of living a life where you’re not inspired by what you’re doing? Well said Lucian.
Luciano: The deeper the water the happier he is. Especially when it comes to disposing of the bodies of rival gang members.
Lucienne: Stylish and suave is Lucienne’s definitive look and he knows a whole lot more about political history than he does about engines. He might seem a little arrogant, but surely someone has to be otherwise an entire word would cease to exist. Anyway, he’s not really. He’s just playing.
Lucio: There's a few out there with a similar attitude, and they can’t all be right, but Lucio thinks he’s the best lover on Earth.
Ludwig: The bashful maths genius who rarely hasn’t got a smile on his face. The only times you'll see him frustrated are when he's in his office, knee-deep in some problem or other. He spent so long trying to solve Fermat's Theorem he almost went insane. It might explain why he wears silly hats in public, not that he has much self-awareness anyway, god love him.
Luigi: The motorcycle mechanic who knows everyone in town.
Luis: See Louis, except Luis is even less subtle, if that's possible.
Luka: He's out there, man. In summer you'll find him in Mexico swan-diving from the tops of very tall cliffs.
Lukas: His origins are eastern European and he has far more grunt that his Australian/American/English male namesake (Lucas). Designed to blend into the background, Lukas gets on with things while at the same time completely ignoring anyone who he considers to be remotely idiotic. (Unless, they happen to be female and beautiful.)
Luke: Luke exists out there somewhere between a fluke and a stroke of genius. He courts disaster with a grin on his face but he can easily fall into a heap if the wind changes direction.
Lulu: Oh man, you're likely to find this dude somewhere in the following: in jail; on stage; on a cave dive at 220 metres sucking a Heliox mix. If he's alive let me know, can you? He owes me 1200 bucks.
Luther: Far from being as boring as bat shit, Luther plots an intricate course in life and away he goes, out the back door first, usually, enroute to the clothes line and only because he’s a stickler for spotlessly clean underwear, and plenty of it. If travelling for more than a few weeks, other than two dozen pairs of jocks, he’ll ensure he has six empty plastic bags in which to place soiled linen because under no circumstances would he allow the rest of his luggage to be infected.
Lutz: An organised and happy chap with European parents who is more concerned with the journey than the destination. Like many Euros he’s happiest when naked. He is also an experimental cook and lover.
Lyal: Lyal is a gentle, educated man. Yes, it’s true that he is basically identical to his twin brother (Lyall) but for some reason known only to the gods, one ‘l’ at the end of his name provides him with a more calming aspect, both internally and externally. We have no idea why this is. Anyway, Lyal makes a fine father, a competent and trusted mediator and a patient and attentive lover.
Lyall: Lyall uses a heavy breathing technique to remove stress from his body. Sometimes you can see him sitting there at his desk, breathing deeply for hours. I say, Lyall, old boy, why don't you go outside with that computer that's giving you so much grief, get a brick and smash the b-Jesus out of it. Computers are a dime a dozen, these days, and you more than most will benefit from standing on green grass in bare feet.
Lyle: Yes, like his twin brothers Lyal and Lyall, Lyle is a centred man who thinks about things and who ponders life. He certainly wouldn’t risk all his savings on a hot tip that someone gave him for the stock market, no way.
Lynden: I wonder if anyone calls him Lyn? Anyway, Lynden is a proper, considerate and well-weighted gentleman. (PS- the thicker the book, the better.)
Lyndon: No, not a salty dog living alone on his yacht, even though he could. Lyndon is thoughtful and wise, and not prone to impulse, but don't think he won't contemplate all or any options when it comes to pleasing his lover. Too right. He's a compassionate man, after all.
Lynn: Lynn can cope with the best and the worst and he looks for the good in people, but if you want to negotiate an armistice then get him on the team pronto. End of story.
Lyric: Oddly enough he can't hold a tune to save his life, and he's just about fed up with people asking him if he's in a band. What he does do, and very well I might add, is weld. At the start he did it as a tradesmen, but that wasn't him. These days you can see the spoils of his handiwork at his property. Large, crazy and haunting metal sculptures are everywhere. So, while he doesn't sing, the wind certainly does when it blows through his art.
